I’d really like a fresh pair, same kind and size, please! Also, I got a jigsaw puzzle, but I think I want to swap it for one with a fancier design and about 500 fewer pieces, but I still want it to be just as challenging. Can you help me out?
Oh, I totally blanked on my email—sorry! But my name is Yara Ito and my zip code is 75284. Will that work?

Oh gosh, I don’t have the order ID handy—my desk is a mess right now! If you could look up my recent orders for me, that would be amazing. The boots and the puzzle were in the same order, if that helps!

Yes, that all sounds right! For the puzzle, I don’t have a specific theme in mind—just something that looks really cool or fancy, maybe something with art or architecture? As long as it’s around 1000 pieces and still tricky, I’m happy to see what you’ve got.

And using PayPal for any payment stuff is perfect. Thanks for helping me sort this out!
Ooh, let’s go with the fantasy theme, intermediate difficulty! That sounds fun and fancy enough for me. And yes, please go ahead with both exchanges just like you described. Thank you so much!
That’s awesome, thank you! I’ll keep an eye out for the email and get those returns sorted. Appreciate all your help—have a great day! ###STOP###
